relevant_files.role: LanguageInfo struct definition and get_language_info function

conventions.commits: Conventional Commits format with types (feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore); all commits must be GPG-signed with --signoff flag; Developer Certificate of Origin required
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files using tree_sitter::Parser and tree_sitter::Query; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test functions named test_<language>_<behavior>
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings; clippy lints enforced: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (deny); must_use_candidate, redundant_clone, needless_pass_by_value, large_enum_variant (warn)
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; no unwrap/expect in production code (test-code exemptions via cfg_attr); bounds checking on node byte ranges before extracting text

patterns: Language modules follow consistent structure: ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, optional REFERENCE_QUERY, optional IMPORT_QUERY, optional DEFUSE_QUERY as module-level constants
Each language handler includes extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance as optional handler functions
LanguageInfo struct wired in get_language_info match arm and get_ts_language match arm; extension map in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP array
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local declarations, assignments) and read sites (identifier usage) with capture group suffixes like @write.local, @read.usage
Inheritance extraction walks child nodes to find extends/implements clauses and extracts type names from those clauses

related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: This is the issue being researched

constraints: All languages must be unconditionally compiled in (no lang-* feature gates); every registered extension is always available at runtime
tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace.dependencies in Cargo.toml with a version pin
PHP language name must be added to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs for .php extension
PHP must be added to supported_languages() slice in lang.rs
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis (def-use tracking); without it, identifier resolution is incomplete
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests for: ELEMENT_QUERY extraction (functions, classes, interfaces, enums), DEFUSE_QUERY write/read site detection, extract_inheritance for base classes and interfaces, extract_function_name for method names, find_receiver_type for enclosing class, find_method_for_receiver for method lookup. Integration tests verify language registration and end-to-end analysis.

library_findings.version: latest from crates.io (recommend checking current version)
library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar node types: function_definition, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration; fields: name, body; inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) children
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level) from method_declaration (in class body); class_declaration has 'name' field and 'body' field; inheritance uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields); enums support class_interface_clause for implements

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter::Language, tree_sitter::Query, tree_sitter::QueryCursor, tree_sitter::Node; methods: child_by_field_name, named_child, start_byte, end_byte, kind, parent
library_findings.notes: Core parsing library; all language handlers use Query API to extract nodes; field access via child_by_field_name is primary pattern

approaches.name: Minimal PHP Integration (CSS-style)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency, create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only (no DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance handlers). Register in mod.rs get_language_info and get_ts_language. Add .php to EXTENSION_MAP and 'php' to supported_languages.
cons: Does not fully satisfy issue requirements for complete language support

approaches.name: Full PHP Integration with DEFUSE_QUERY (Recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency. Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, enums), CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY (local declarations, assignments, identifier reads), and extract_inheritance handler. Register in mod.rs with all handlers. Add .php to EXTENSION_MAP and 'php' to supported_languages. Include comprehensive unit tests.
pros: Complete language support matching Java/Python pattern
Enables def-use analysis for PHP code
cons: Requires DEFUSE_QUERY design (more complex than simple languages)

approaches.name: Full PHP with Optional Handlers (Conservative)
approaches.description: Like Approach 2 but with extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver as optional (set to None in LanguageInfo). DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance required. Reduces handler implementation burden while maintaining semantic analysis.
pros: Def-use and inheritance work without method-lookup handlers
Can add handlers in follow-up PR if needed
cons: Method lookup features unavailable until handlers added

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP Integration with DEFUSE_QUERY). The issue explicitly asks to 'model after Java' and Java includes DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because it enables def-use tracking, a core feature of aptu-coder's semantic analysis. Without it, identifier resolution is incomplete and the tool cannot track variable definitions and uses across scopes. The extract_inheritance handler is needed for class hierarchy analysis. This approach provides complete, production-ready PHP support aligned with existing language patterns.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

(
function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration

(interface_declaration

(enum_declaration

inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node, walk its named children to find base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) nodes. For each base_clause child, iterate its named children to extract name nodes and capture their text as 'extends <name>'. For each class_interface_clause child, iterate its named children to extract name nodes and capture their text as 'implements <name>'. This pattern is documented in tree-sitter-php grammar.js where base_clause is defined as seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)) and class_interface_clause is defined as seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)).

wiring_summary.workspace_dependency: Add tree-sitter-php to [workspace.dependencies] in Cargo.toml with version constraint (e.g., tree-sitter-php = "0.X.Y")
wiring_summary.crate_dependency: Add tree-sitter-php = { workspace = true } to [dependencies] in crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml
wiring_summary.module_declaration: Add pub mod php; to crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/mod.rs after the other language module declarations
wiring_summary.language_info_match_arm: Add 'php' => Some(LanguageInfo { ... }) match arm to get_language_info() function in mod.rs with all required fields populated from php module constants and handlers
wiring_summary.ts_language_match_arm: Add '"php" => Some(tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE.into())' to get_ts_language() function in mod.rs
wiring_summary.extension_map_entry: Add ("php", "php") entry to EXTENSION_MAP array in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs
wiring_summary.supported_languages_entry: Add "php" string to supported_languages() slice in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs
